name: rules-rtdb-r8-combined-check
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r8-combined-check" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). a root-level .write predicate reading newData.child('owner') sees {item:{...}} for a write one level deeper, so hasChildren(['owner']) is false — production denies all writes; the simulator must project newData at the rule node identically.
